Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production pixel-art sprite atlas for a crafting game. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY; all subjects must be replaced by the exact NEW component list below. Match its crisp colorful 16-bit three-quarter pixel art, warm metal highlights, visible square pixels, strong readable silhouettes.
Create EXACTLY 12 isolated inventory icons in an EXACT UNIFORM 4-COLUMN by 3-ROW GRID on pure solid #000000 black. Overall 4:3 canvas, target 1600x1200. Each cell square with exactly one coherent icon centered, taking at most 75% of cell width and height. Keep at least 45 pixels of pure black gutter inside ALL cell edges. Each icon fully visible, no overlapping cells. No grid lines, frames, labels, typography, logos, watermarks, floor planes, or outside shadows. This is a sprite sheet, NOT a game screenshot. No existing objects from the style reference.
EXACT order, left to right and top to bottom:
Row 1 column 1: Ball Bearings — Small polished steel ball bearings in an open square tin.
Row 1 column 2: Electric Motors — Compact silver electric motor with copper coils and short drive shaft.
Row 1 column 3: Motion Sensors — Small white motion sensor module with a faceted pale dome.
Row 1 column 4: Optical Lenses — Two thick blue glass optical lenses in brass rim holders.
Row 2 column 1: Microcontrollers — Tiny dark green microcontroller chip board with gold contact pins.
Row 2 column 2: Permanent Magnets — Red horseshoe magnet beside small silver disc magnets.
Row 2 column 3: Water Pumps — Compact teal water pump with brass inlet and outlet.
Row 2 column 4: Pressure Valves — Brass pressure valve with red wheel handle and tiny dial.
Row 3 column 1: Flexible Hoses — Coiled green flexible hose with brass end fittings.
Row 3 column 2: Wire Spools — Wooden spool wound with red insulated electrical wire.
Row 3 column 3: Ceramic Pieces — Stack of cream ceramic discs and a short ceramic tube.
Row 3 column 4: Filter Cartridges — Two white pleated filter cartridges with blue end caps.
Some items are technical parts; keep visually distinct from each other. Bright steel, copper, teal, blue, red accents. No smooth CGI, no blurry painting. Exactly twelve sprites, no extra decorative objects.
